brand_lede: Build product-grade floating interactions with the same behavior in Web Components and Vue.
hero_title: Build the moments around your interface.
hero_copy: Give help, reveal context, guide choices, and protect focus without rebuilding the hard interaction behavior for every feature.
patterns_title: What your product can do next.
patterns_copy: Every pattern is a working interface, not a static mockup. Switch its implementation when you are ready to compare the API surface.
foundation_title: One interaction model. Your own interface.
foundation_copy: Floating UI Plus supplies positioning, open state, dismissal, focus, collections, portals, and multilingual search. Your application keeps its markup, semantics, and visual language.
foundation_state_copy: Use the same interaction rules across Web Components and Vue.
foundation_search_copy: Compose cancellation-aware fuzzy search with your own input, options, and ARIA.
packages_copy: Package versions come from npm. The interaction model stays consistent across the surfaces you choose.
pattern_tooltip_heading: Help that follows pointer and keyboard intent.
pattern_tooltip_description: Offer compact, accessible guidance without interrupting the task.
pattern_popover_description: Reveal anchored detail, actions, and dismissal behavior where it matters.
pattern_menu_description: Build keyboard-ready command menus from one collection registry.
pattern_nested_menu_description: Coordinate submenus, focus, and dismissal across a complete action tree.
pattern_client_point_heading: A surface can follow intent, not just an element.
pattern_client_point_description: Position context from pointer coordinates with a virtual reference.
pattern_combobox_description: Search multilingual destinations with fuzzy matching and accessible list navigation.
pattern_placement_description: Compare all typed placements and understand how the surface responds.
pattern_middleware_heading: Position with the constraints you mean.
pattern_middleware_description: See how offset, shift, flip, size, arrow, hide, inline, and auto-placement cooperate.
pattern_modal_description: Trap focus, lock scroll, layer Escape dismissal, and return people where they started.
example_tooltip_build: We combined floating-root with hover(), focus(), dismiss(), role(), safePolygon(), and arrow middleware to build contextual help that works for both pointer and keyboard users.
example_popover_build: We composed floating-root, floating-portal, click dismissal, and offset/flip/shift middleware to build an anchored details panel that remains connected after it moves in the DOM.
example_menu_build: We used floating-list with navigation, typeahead, and loop plus one collection registry to build a command navigator with dependable keyboard movement.
example_nested_menu_build: We coordinated floating-tree, floating-node, nested floating-list, and descendant dismissal to build a command hierarchy whose submenus retain the right parent focus.
example_client_point_build: We combined clientPoint(), hover({move: true}), and a virtual reference with flip and shift middleware to build context that follows a precise pointer position.
example_combobox_build: We composed SearchController, createFuzzySearchSource(), listNavigation(), role(), and floating-portal to build a multilingual destination picker without tying search to one UI framework.
example_placement_build: We used the typed Placement surface and offset middleware to build a placement lab where one product decision immediately updates the floating surface.
example_middleware_build: We applied the same floating-root primitive to isolated offset, shift, flip, arrow, size, autoPlacement, hide, and inline experiments so each layout constraint is visible in action.
example_modal_build: We composed floating-tree, floating-node, floating-portal, floating-overlay, and floating-focus-manager to build layered dialogs with inert surroundings, scroll locking, return focus, and ordered Escape dismissal.
